description: Defines interfaces, data structures, and constants for F1AP DU positioning handling in a 3GPP-compliant 5G network, including TRP info, positioning info, measurement requests, and responses.

classes.name: ocudu::odu::f1ap_du_positioning_handler
classes.description: Interface class for handling F1AP DU positioning requests, including TRP info, positioning info, and measurement requests.

methods.name: request_trp_info
methods.description: Requests supported TRP information as per TS 38.473, Section 8.13.8.

methods.name: request_positioning_info
methods.description: Requests UE positioning information asynchronously as per TS 38.473, Section 8.13.9.

methods.name: request_positioning_measurement
methods.description: Requests UE positioning measurement asynchronously as per TS 38.473, Section 8.13.2.
